name: IDRX
oneLiner: IDRX is PT IDRX Indo Inovasi's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds with KYC-gated mint and redeem.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah (IDR) fiat reserves and government bonds held 1:1 by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi; CertiK-audited smart contracts with multisig + timelock controls
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of IDRX for Indonesian rupiah through IDRX platform after KYC verification; native multichain deployment with built-in bridge functions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: IDR fiat reserves and government bonds

mintAuthority.summary: IDRX is issued by PT IDRX with centralized KYC-gated 1:1 mint/redeem against IDR fiat and government bonds; audited materials state the direct MINTER_ROLE is assigned to an MPC wallet, while multisig/timelock controls apply to upgrade and role-admin paths.

controls.label: PT IDRX issuance backend
controls.evidence: PT IDRX operates centralized KYC-gated mint and redeem of IDRX against custodied IDR reserves and government bonds across its native-multichain deployment.

controls.label: IDRX role/upgrade multisig + 24h timelock admin
controls.evidence: IDRX audit materials describe multi-member approval and a 24-hour timelock for privileged admin/upgrade paths, but explicitly state the direct MINTER_ROLE cannot use the timelock and is assigned to an MPC wallet.

review.evidence: IDRX materials and CertiK-audit coverage describe a centralized fiat issuer with KYC-gated mint/redeem. The audit states direct MINTER_ROLE minting is assigned to an MPC wallet because that function cannot use the timelock; multisig/timelock controls bound role/upgrade changes, not the direct mint path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Direct minter MPC and role/upgrade timelock split taken from the IDRX CertiK assessment; exact on-chain signer/threshold and per-chain role holders were not independently confirmed in this pass.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain MPC wallet address holding MINTER_ROLE and the multisig signer set/threshold for role and upgrade admin changes.
Resolve per-chain minter-admin and proxy admin across Polygon, Base, BSC, Klaytn, Gnosis, Etherlink, Worldchain, and Solana.
